name: 86 Chaos 16.0.92 System Admin Authority and Push Repair State Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.92 System Admin Authority and Push Repair State Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.92 System Admin Authority and Push Repair State Fix
notes: System Administrator platform authority is separated from restaurant and workspace role text.
The protected founding System Administrator can remain Kitchen in the restaurant while retaining platform System Administrator access.
Unsafe tenant-editable profile fields no longer grant platform System Administrator authority.
Push repair links preserve the repair nonce long enough to activate once, then clear temporary link state after terminal outcomes.
Push repair dismissal uses stable authenticated user, workspace, device, and nonce identity instead of changing failure or status fields.
